note: Adapted from Emerson's (1928) description of the species, originally in English; the original describes only the soldier, with no worker or alate and no nymph. Figure numbers, localities and collection records have been omitted, as has the text on the genus Rhinotermes and the subgenus Schedorhinotermes that follows in the same scanned section and does not belong to this species.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: In the syntype soldiers of C. amanii the junction of the lateral margins and the posterior margin of the head forms a sharper angle and the arc of the lateral profile is flatter, but the postmentum is similar. In some specimens antennal segments 2 and 3 are about equal in length, so that they cannot be distinguished from the description of var. subintacta.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, sparsely covered with long setae, narrowing anteriorly, with the sides and the posterior margin rounded; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 very short with a very weak boundary from segment 4; labrum triangular, pointed apically, with several long setae. Thorax paler than the head; posterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave, sides rounded, densely covered with setae; abdominal tergites densely covered with setae, paler than the head. Measurements: head length 1.63–1.77, head width 0.97–1.00, antennal length 1.22, pronotal length 0.38–0.40 and width 0.70, hind tibia 0.76–0.83, left mandible 0.67–0.72.
